exercises.why: **состоит** — состоя́ть (imperfective): to consist (of); to be a member of, to occupy a position in, to be in a position, to belong to. Wiktionary: со- + стоя́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **состоим** — состоя́ть (imperfective): to consist (of); to be a member of, to occupy a position in, to be in a position, to belong to. Wiktionary: со- + стоя́ть.

exercises.why: **схватим** — схвати́ть (perfective): to grasp, to grab, to seize, to snap, to snatch, to catch, to catch hold of. Wiktionary: с- + хвати́ть.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: (usually, impersonal) to happen, to occur, to come about
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: сно́ва — anew; счита́ть — to calculate; случи́ться — (usually, impersonal) to happen, to occur, to come about; споко́йный — calm (unworried, free from anger).
**схватим** — схвати́ть (perfective): to grasp, to grab, to seize, to snap, to snatch, to catch, to catch hold of. Wiktionary: с- + хвати́ть.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **сойти** — сойти́ (perfective): to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off; (figuratively) to come off, to disappear, to go from; to pass by; (figuratively) to pass for, to be taken for. Wiktionary: со- + -йти́.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to agree (to), to consent, to assent
to grasp, to grab, to seize, to snap, to snatch, to catch, to catch hold of
to abate, to fall (to decrease or become less in strength)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: согласи́ться — to agree (to), to consent, to assent; состоя́ть — to consist (of); схвати́ть — to grasp, to grab, to seize, to snap, to snatch, to catch, to catch hold of; спасть — to abate, to fall (to decrease or become less in strength).

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off
to communicate, to report, to let know
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: сойти́ — to go down, to come down, to descend, to get off; собы́тие — event, occurrence, incident; сообщи́ть — to communicate, to report, to let know; сосе́д — neighbour.
